styles.name: No Colour
styles.description: Pure line art and contour baseline with transparent or white background, zero color fills.

styles.name: Classic Cel Shading
styles.description: Sharp, discrete 2-3 step shadow boundaries with hard-edge posterization.

styles.name: Soft Gradient Shading
styles.description: Continuous smooth tonal gradients computed across normal vectors.

styles.name: Hybrid Cel + Soft Shading
styles.description: Crisp cel shadow core coupled with soft gradient ambient occlusion edges.

styles.name: Flat Illustration
styles.description: Vibrant unshaded color blocks with consistent linework and graphical clarity.

styles.name: Painterly
styles.description: Rich brushstroke texture, visible bristle marks, and blended edge transitions.

styles.name: Watercolour
styles.description: Simulated pigment diffusion, wet-on-wet pooling, paper granulation, and edge darkening.

styles.name: Coloured Pencil
styles.description: Directional hatching texture, toothy paper resist, and layered wax pigment buildup.

styles.name: Marker
styles.description: Semi-translucent ink strokes with overlap pooling and streak artifacts.

styles.name: Manga Screentone
styles.description: Half-tone dot patterns, crosshatch screens, and frequency-locked stippling.

styles.name: Comic Book
styles.description: Four-color CMYK Ben-Day dots, heavy inking lines, and saturated pop-art primaries.

styles.name: Oil Paint
styles.description: Thick impasto relief, specular sheen, and rich oily blending.

styles.name: Gouache
styles.description: Opaque matte color fields with velvety finish and crisp clean edges.

styles.name: Pastel Palette
styles.description: Chalky texture, soft powdery blending, muted desaturated pastel tones.

styles.name: Neon / Cyberpunk
styles.description: High-contrast dark backdrops with vivid fluorescent glows, chromatic aberration, and emission blooms.

styles.name: Monochrome
styles.description: High-fidelity tonal range across single-tint inks (sepia, carbon black, cyanotype).
